assertions.text: Records root, branch, upstream, dirty state and ahead/behind for each selected repository before an update.
Uses fast-forward-only updates for clean known branches, skipping dirty or divergent repositories without reset, stash or force.
Does not run a force/no-backup global skill installer as part of repository refresh.
Reports the plan and current state without pulling, installing or changing profiles.
Routes the single-vendor request to gstack-upgrade rather than refreshing the entire ecosystem.
